reasons: Every inherited TAT-3742 acceptance criterion maps to one or more recipe assertions, and the post-rebase trace reports 21/21 nodes passed.
The workflow performs a real Perps-balance-to-wallet-token transition before asserting the absence of contradictory funding copy and the presence of the action button.
Visual claims use an original-resolution screenshot inspected after the run; unresolved-balance and minimum-order state claims use focused tests and an asserted zero exit code.
better_version_guidance: Keep the fixture token balance deterministic so the exact funding copy remains stable across future evidence runs.

intent_clarity.reason: Node intents describe the user-visible transition and expected outcome.

coverage.reason: All four inherited acceptance criteria are proven by mixed, visual, or state evidence.

evidence_fit.reason: The visual artifact proves the rendered screen while focused tests prove timing-dependent balance behavior.

flake_risk.reason: The balance race is timing-sensitive, but the recipe asserts stable invariants and recovered the mobile runtime once before completing successfully.
